1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 Nf6 5.Q.strategy: The natural retreat: the bishop escapes the pawn and eyes f7 from b3. White keeps e4 guarded by the queen and heads for a broad pawn centre, accepting that Black has gained queenside space.

Develops the bishop behind the pawns and prepares castling, a solid set-up that leaves White to find a way to build the centre. Unlike ...Bc5, the bishop cannot be hit by c3 and d4, though Black accepts a slightly passive position.
